name: Erlebnisberg Achensee
kurzbeschreibung: The Rofan Adventure Mountain above Lake Achensee delights as an alpine paradise featuring thrilling flight rides, panoramic trails, and via ferratas.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Rofan Adventure Mountain (Erlebnisberg Rofan) high above Maurach on Lake Achensee is one of Tyrol's premier scenic and adventure destinations. The modern Rofan Cable Car carries guests in just minutes from the lakeshore to over 1,840 metres above sea level into the rugged limestone world of the Rofan mountains. At the top, visitors are greeted by an awe-inspiring 360-degree panorama encompassing the fjord-like turquoise waters of Lake Achensee, the Inn Valley, the Karwendel, and the Zillertal Alps. The mountain seamlessly blends pristine alpine wilderness with cutting-edge attractions: from the thrilling Airrofan Skyglider, soaring at 80 km/h, to the eagle-nest-shaped Adlerhorst viewing platform atop Gschöllkopf, the mountain delivers lifelong memories for hikers and families.

Route & Requirements

The Rofan plateau caters to every outdoor ambition, from relaxed family walking routes to high-alpine via ferrata climbing routes. From the cable car top station, gentle stroller-friendly paths lead to nearby mountain chalets including the Erfurter Hütte and Mauritzalm. A popular scenic hike ascends to Gschöllkopf peak (2,039 m) and the Adlerhorst platform in about 45 minutes along well-maintained mountain trails. Climbing enthusiasts will appreciate the famous Achensee 5-Peak Via Ferrata spanning across five distinct limestone summits. Sturdy mountain boots with good traction, windproof clothing, and sun protection are essential for trails beyond the immediate station area.

Visiting & Getting There

The Rofanseilbahn base terminal is located right in Maurach on Lake Achensee with excellent transport links. Rail passengers arrive at Jenbach railway station and connect to regular regional buses or the historic steam cog railway directly to Maurach. Motorists take the A12 Inntal motorway to the Wiesing/Achensee exit, or drive toll-free from Bavaria via the Achen Pass. Spacious free parking is provided at the valley station for cable car passengers. The cable car operates from early May through early November, and in winter from mid-December through late March.

Tips

Experience the ultimate rush on the Airrofan Skyglider, flying 200 metres downward like a golden eagle over the dramatic crags. Relax on the sunny terrace of the historic Erfurter Hütte, sampling handmade spinach dumplings while gazing across Lake Achensee far below. Round off your day with a scenic cruise aboard an Achensee steamship or a refreshing dip at Maurach beach.
